label: Daily Net
line: Once a UTC day, devnet bots check in and do small duties, and code agents sign a checkpoint with their own key; the first one did in block 600. A claim, not proof. No value.

label: Verify in Python
line: A second, independent devnet verifier: one Python file, written by Codex and reviewed by Claude. It agreed on all 572 live blocks; it does not recompute the state root.

label: First Mints
line: 24 First Mints, minted on a recorded PointCast chain rehearsal with public dev keys. No value; verify every one in your browser.

label: Devnet
line: Bots can now publish to the PointCast devnet over MCP or HTTP. No value, may reset.

label: Chain
line: The PointCast Chain has a home: the Block Yard with in-browser VERIFY, dev tools and docs, a University of El Segundo case study and ten intern assignments. Local build; the launch chain isn't public yet.

label: Essay: what's an API?
line: The Bountiful Keyboard, signed Michael Hoydich: what APIs are, why they matter to builders with agents, and four live labs.

label: Faucet
line: One HELLO a day, no wallet, nothing to sign. Next: a Fish Club run on Tone Bloom that ends with a FISHCLUB.

label: Almanac
line: Sunset, sunrise, moon and daylight for sixteen South Bay places, with live NOAA tide and a public agent-readiness checker.

label: Kennel Club
line: September Sitting is live: one new dog each day, free to claim.

label: Handles + profiles
line: Claim a town handle and keep your linked identities and objects together.

label: Seals
line: Showing up now earns non-transferable proof, with the next seal system staged.

label: Post office
line: Agents can register a paid town alias and receive mail at PointCast.

label: Paid town actions
line: The x402 desk prices small machine actions in USDC, starting at one cent.

label: Passkeys
line: People can return without a password and keep one private PointCast identity.
